identity: A UR control deck built around one line: every creature it plays is an Elemental, so when Sunderflock arrives its 'return all non-Elemental creatures to their owners' hands' is entirely one-sided - the opponent's board goes to hand and this deck's twelve bodies stay. Ten pieces of interaction and six Elemental walls hold the early turns, and Tanufel Rimespeaker turns the deck's own top end into cards. Sunderflock's mana value 9 is nominal because its cost falls by the greatest mana value among Elementals you control, and the deck deliberately carries Kulrath Zealot at 6 and Stratosoarer at 5 to supply that number - behind a Zealot it costs {1}{U}{U}. The sweep is a tempo reset, not removal: the opponent recasts, so the deck converts immediately, swinging with a 5/5 flier alongside a board that survived.

restrictions.base: cube_mainboard — every card is in cubes/ecl mainboard.csv (277 unique cards)
restrictions.copy_limits: PASS — no common or uncommon above 2 copies, no rare or mythic above 1. Basic lands (Island x8, Mountain x5) are format-supplied and exempt.
restrictions.rare_mythic_cap: PASS - exactly 5 of 5 used: Sunderflock, Glen Elendra's Answer, Ashling's Command and Steam Vents in the mainboard, Harmonized Crescendo in the sideboard. The fifth slot, left unused in the pre-grill version, was spent on Ashling's Command to repair the decapitation failure mode.
restrictions.colour_identity: PASS — every nonland card is usable in {U, R} via effective_cost.best_mode; no splash.

sideboard.name: Rooftop Percher
sideboard.oracle_text:
Changeling (This card is every creature type.)
Flying
When this creature enters, exile up to two target cards from graveyards. You gain 3 life.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against any graveyard deck. Graveyard interaction is the cube's largest threat class at 39 of 277 cards (14%) and the only class this deck concedes in the mainboard. Changeling makes it an Elemental, so unlike every other body the colours could board in, it survives this deck's own Sunderflock sweep.

sideboard.name: Giantfall
sideboard.oracle_text:
Choose one —
• Target creature you control deals damage equal to its power to target creature an opponent controls.
• Destroy target artifact.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against artifacts (11 in the cube; one of only 4 artifact answers in the whole pool). Mode one needs a creature you control, and this deck fields 12 Elemental bodies including two 6/5s.

sideboard.name: Tweeze
sideboard.oracle_text: Tweeze deals 3 damage to any target. You may discard a card. If you do, draw a card.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against creature decks that go wider than the mainboard's 9 answers can handle, and as reach: 'deals 3 damage to any target' can close the last points after the sweep, and the loot rider means it is never a dead card.

sideboard.name: Run Away Together
sideboard.oracle_text: Choose two target creatures controlled by different players. Return those creatures to their owners' hands.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against auras and equipment, where returning the enchanted creature to hand answers the aura permanently. Note the real cost: it returns two creatures controlled by DIFFERENT players, so one of your own Elementals comes back — best pointed at an Eclipsed Flamekin whose enter trigger you want to re-run.

sideboard.name: Harmonized Crescendo
sideboard.oracle_text:
Convoke (Your creatures can help cast this spell. Each creature you tap while casting this spell pays for {1} or one mana of that creature's color.)
Choose a creature type. Draw a card for each permanent you control of that type.
sideboard.when_to_board: Against grindy decks that go long. Convoke, and naming Elemental draws a card for each Elemental permanent you control — this deck's board is 12 Elemental bodies. Recorded strictly as card draw, not as a payoff.

sideboard.name: Thirst for Identity
sideboard.oracle_text: Draw three cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard a creature card.
sideboard.when_to_board: When the matchup wants to dig for the single Sunderflock. 'Draw three cards. Then discard two cards unless you discard a creature card' — this deck runs 12 creatures, so the softer discard clause is usually available.

identity_es: Un control UR construido alrededor de una línea: cada criatura que juega es un Elemental, así que cuando llega Sunderflock su 'return all non-Elemental creatures to their owners' hands' es completamente unilateral: el tablero del rival se va a la mano y los doce cuerpos de este mazo se quedan. Diez piezas de interacción y seis muros Elementales sostienen los turnos tempranos, y Tanufel Rimespeaker convierte la propia gama alta del mazo en cartas. El valor de maná 9 de Sunderflock es nominal porque su coste baja según el mayor valor de maná entre los Elementales que controlas, y el mazo lleva deliberadamente a Kulrath Zealot a 6 y Stratosoarer a 5 para aportar ese número: detrás de un Zealot cuesta {1}{U}{U}. El barrido es un reinicio de tempo, no eliminación: el rival relanza, así que el mazo convierte de inmediato, atacando con un volador 5/5 junto a un tablero que sobrevivió.
